title: Automated variant validation and pin recommendation workflow for open LLM intake
creator: Maya Singh
description: Build an automated pipeline stage that, after weights conversion, runs a deterministic variant equivalence and performance validation suite and emits a recommended pin and quantization profile for serving. The goal is to reduce manual triage for new community models by automatically rejecting broken conversions, surfacing reproducible regressions, and producing a confident 'pin candidate' that downstream serving and Console rollouts can consume.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline stage consumes converted model artifact and produces a JSON 'variant_report' that includes correctness, perf, and stability signals
Automated equivalence tests detect conversion-induced output drift above configurable thresholds and mark variant as 'rejected'
Pin recommendation engine outputs: suggested pin label, quantization profile (int8/4 or fp16), and confidence score
Integration test: new stage runs in CI on a sample of three community models and generates reports stored in artifact gateway
Alerts created for 'high drift' variants and links added to onboarding dashboard
steps: Define deterministic sample set and seed prompts for equivalence checks (shared with evals team)
Extend conversion runner to emit canonical input/output pairs for converted artifact
Implement lightweight equivalence checker: token-level BLEU/EM-like metrics + embedding similarity threshold
Run perf harness: 1) cold-start latency 2) 95th percentile latency distribution 3) peak memory and kv-cache growth profile
Estimate quantization sensitivity using synthetic quantization passes and compare generation divergence
Aggregate signals into 'variant_report' and apply policy rules to decide accept/reject/pin-candidate
Publish 'variant_report' to artifact gateway and notify onboarding Slack channel with dashboard link
Add an on-call playbook for frequent false-positives and deterministic rerun commands
metrics: % of new community models with automated pin suggested (target >= 60% after rollout)
False-positive rejection rate in validation (< 5% target)
Median time from weight upload to variant_report availability (< 30 minutes)
Regression detection precision (>= 90% for high confidence detections)
comments: 2026-01-20: Kickoff with conversion and evals owners. Agreed to reuse existing sample prompt sets from evals/commons. - Maya

2026-02-02: Design review: quantization sensitivity will use two-stage approach (cheap synthetic pass + focused full-gen for borderline cases). Action: ENG to prototype lightweight synthetic pass. - Carlos

2026-02-15: Prototype equivalence checker shows good signal on 7 models (detected a conversion bug in a community checkpoint that had truncated final layer). Filing follow-up to artifact gateway for storing canonical IO pairs. - Carlos
2026-02-28: PM feedback: need UX contract for Console to display 'pin confidence' and reason codes. Created PM ticket PM-462 for Console integration. - Lena (PM)
2026-03-05: Security: requirement added to ensure variant_report does not leak private training data; redaction and PII checks mandatory. Added to scope. - Security Team
2026-03-09: Added Canary policy: only auto-approve pin candidates with confidence >= 0.92 for initial 2-week rollout, others go to manual review. - Carlos
notes: Trade-offs considered: strict token-level equality is brittle across conversion paths; we combine multiple weak signals (generation divergence, embedding similarity, perf deltas) to make robust decisions. We will tune thresholds per-model family (decoder-only vs. encoder-decoder). Also implementing an explainable reason-code in report to make Console reviews faster.
